name: Files
descr: The loader of the files: a pack of them onto the elements in one call, and a derived picture painted beside those that ask for one. It is the second half of an import and goes after the goods: a file hangs on an element by its id, and the ids are what the answer of the Goods loader gave back - write them into the rows of this call. The files themselves ride with the call, so the size of one pack is the size of one request: split a big load into several calls.

commands.name: CmdAdd
commands.descr: Hangs a pack of files on their elements and paints a derived picture where a profile asks for one. A file whose element is not yours goes back at once and is said in the answer. Takes the right of those elements, and no setting right with it: a derived picture is a file, not a setting.

params.name: files
params.descr: the files of the call. Each entry: path, entity, elem_id, and kind_key, real_name, profile when they are needed. The list may come from a jsonl of your machine, one entry per line.

params.name: profile
params.descr: the profile every entry that carries none is derived by - a second picture beside the one that landed, in the group the recipe names. Empty - nothing is derived. The Profiles tool answers the recipes.
